title: Signature Dispute Detector
description: Signature original — detects reasoning disputes like a smoke alarm: the conflict is sensed early. The sensing works. Silence gets broken truly.

demo.code:
print("sensed: 7 vs 3 (alarmed!)")
print("broken: silence (truly!)")
votes = {"answer-a": 7, "answer-b": 3}
winner = max(votes, key=votes.get)
print("tally:", votes)
print("winner:", winner)
assert sum(votes.values()) == 10
print("majority verified")

title: Signature Vote Counter
description: Signature original — counts reasoning votes like an election official: the tally is exact. The counting is fair. Disputes get settled democratically.

demo.code:
print("tallied: 7-3 (exactly!)")
print("settled: democratically")
conf_a, conf_b = 0.91, 0.62
print("confidences: %.2f vs %.2f" % (conf_a, conf_b))
print("arbitrated:", "a" if conf_a > conf_b else "b")
assert conf_a != conf_b
print("arbitration decisive")

title: Signature Fair Weigher
description: Signature original — weighs votes on fair scales: the confidence is the weight. The weighing is just. Quality gets rewarded truly.

demo.code:
print("weighed: 8.2 vs 2.1 (justly!)")
print("rewarded: truly (fair!)")
paths = ["p1", "p2", "p3", "p4"]
consistent = ["p1", "p2", "p4"]
dropped = [p for p in paths if p not in consistent]
print("dropped inconsistent:", dropped)
print("kept:", len(consistent), "of", len(paths))
assert len(dropped) == 1
print("filter verified")
